# ArmSoft SME Trade Public API Docs

> REST API for managing trade operations (products, partners, inventory, documents) in the ArmSoft SME Trade ERP system.
> Base URL: https://api.armsoft.am/trade/v1
> Authentication: API Key via `apiKey` request header
> Languages: Armenian (hy-AM), English (en-US), Russian (ru-RU)

## OpenAPI Specs
- Full spec (auto-generated, all endpoints): ./swagger.json
- Curated spec (products & measure units): ./openapi/openapi.yaml
- Source OpenAPI (modular YAML): ./openapi/openapi.yaml

## Authentication
- Header: `apiKey`
- Optional locale header: `Accept-Language` (`hy-AM`, `en-US`, `ru-RU`)
- Full Access keys: complete CRUD on all resources
- Limited Access keys: read-only product catalog + sale document creation (online store use case)
- 401 when the key is missing or invalid; 403 when Public API is disabled for the key or the key has limited access

## Endpoints (v1)

### Products
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products/list
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products/list/nextpage
- GET /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products
- PUT /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}
- DELETE /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}

### Product Measure Units
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits/list
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits/list/nextpage
- GET /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}
- POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits
- PUT /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}
- DELETE /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}

## Pagination
- Controlled via `pageSize` in request body (0 = all rows)
- Minimum page size: 5000 rows
- Responses include `id` (UUID) and `hasMore` fields
- Fetch next page: POST to `/list/nextpage` with `{ "id": "...", "close": false }`
- Close context early: POST with `{ "id": "...", "close": true }`

## Key Concepts
- Products have a `code` (string identifier), `name`, `baseUnitMeasure`, `vat` (boolean), `showInPriceLists` (boolean)
- Measure units are linked to products via `productCode` + `unitCode`
- All list endpoints support filtering and pagination
- Error responses: `{ "message": "...", "fieldName": "...", "errorCode": "..." }`
- Swagger UI: https://api.armsoft.am/trade/swagger/index.html
